title: Closing the Modality Gap via Simplex-Constrained Representations
abstract: arXiv:2610.32890v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While multimodal contrastive models like CLIP and CLAP successfully learn shared representations, their embeddings typically exhibit a persistent \emph{modality gap}. We propose addressing this separation through a purely geometric approach: changing the embedding domain from the unit sphere, $S^{d-1}$, to the probability simplex, $\Delta^{d-1}$. Although both manifolds share the same intrinsic dimension, the simplex acts as a structural prior; its nonnegative, unit-mass constraints serve as a cross-modal calibration that forces both modalities to ground themselves in the same coordinate system. By attaching lightweight softmax adapters and using Total Variation similarity, we reduce the centroid $\ell_2$ gap by 97--99\% across five multimodal retrieval benchmarks. This confirms that simplicial geometry induces genuine semantic alignment, matching or exceeding the retrieval performance of standard unconstrained models.

translated_title: 通过单纯形约束表示弥合模态差距
translated_abstract: 尽管像CLIP和CLAP这样的多模态对比模型能够成功学习共享表示，它们的嵌入通常表现出持续的模态差距。我们提出通过一种纯几何方法来解决这种分离问题：将嵌入域从单位球面 $S^{d-1}$ 改变为概率单纯形 $\Delta^{d-1}$。尽管两个流形具有相同的内在维度，但单纯形起到了结构先验的作用；其非负、单位质量的约束作为一种跨模态校准，迫使两种模态锚定在同一坐标系中。通过附加轻量级的softmax适配器并使用全变差相似度，我们在五个多模态检索基准上将质心 $\ell_2$ 差距减少了97%至99%。这证实了单纯形几何能够诱导真正的语义对齐，其检索性能与标准无约束模型相当或更优。
tldr: 该论文提出将多模态对比模型的嵌入域从单位球面改为概率单纯形，利用其非负、单位质量的结构约束作为跨模态校准，在五个检索基准上将质心差距减少97%至99%，实现真正的语义对齐。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes changing the embedding domain of multimodal contrastive models from the unit sphere to the probability simplex, where nonnegative unit-mass constraints act as cross-modal calibration, reducing the centroid gap by 97-99% across five retrieval benchmarks and achieving genuine semantic alignment.
